title: Systematic assessment of ISWI subunits reveals that NURF creates local accessibility for proper CTCF function
authors: Iurlaro M; Masoni F; Wirbelauer C; Iskar M; Burger L; Schübeler D
one_liner_zh: 该文通过基因敲除评估ISWI亚基对CTCF位点染色质可及性和绝缘功能的影响，虽涉及TF-DNA结合但以实验表型为主，缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，与课题方法轴不匹配。
abstract: Catalytic activity of the ISWI family of remodelers is critical for nucleosomal organization and DNA binding of transcription factors, including the insulator protein CTCF. To define which subcomplex mediates these diverse functions, we derived a panel of isogenic mouse stem cell lines each lacking one of six ISWI accessory subunits. Individual deletions of subunits of either CERF, RSF, ACF, WICH or NoRC subcomplexes only moderately affect the chromatin landscape, while removal of the NURF-specific subunit BPTF leads to drastic reduction in chromatin accessibility and SNF2H ATPase localization around CTCF sites. While this affects adjacent nucleosome occupancy, it only modestly impacts CTCF binding itself. In the absence of accessibility, the structural function of CTCF is nevertheless impaired resulting in lower occupancy of cohesin and cohesin release factor, and reduced physical insulation at these sites, highlighting the need of NURF-mediated remodeling for open chromatin and proper CTCF function. These results separate local CTCF binding from insulator function in nuclear organization and reveal a specific role for NURF in mediating SNF2H localization and chromatin opening at bound CTCF sites. They designate local accessibility as critical for cohesin positioning and establishment of physical insulation.
abstract_zh: ISWI家族重塑酶的催化活性对于核小体组织和转录因子（包括绝缘蛋白CTCF）的DNA结合至关重要。为确定哪个亚复合物介导这些多样功能，我们构建了一组同基因小鼠干细胞系，每个细胞系缺失六个ISWI辅助亚基之一。单独缺失CERF、RSF、ACF、WICH或NoRC亚复合物的亚基仅适度影响染色质景观，而缺失NURF特异性亚基BPTF则导致CTCF位点周围染色质可及性和SNF2H ATP酶定位的显著减少。虽然这影响相邻核小体占据，但对CTCF结合本身影响较小。在缺乏可及性的情况下，CTCF的结构功能仍受损，导致cohesin和cohesin释放因子的占据降低，以及这些位点的物理绝缘性减弱，凸显了NURF介导的重塑对开放染色质和CTCF正常功能的必要性。这些结果将局部CTCF结合与核组织中的绝缘功能区分开来，并揭示了NURF在介导SNF2H定位和结合CTCF位点染色质开放中的特定作用。它们将局部可及性指定为cohesin定位和物理绝缘建立的关键因素。
